name: 42-warsaw-progress-insight
description: TV-friendly dashboard for the 42 Warsaw Hacks: Learning Progress Insight hackathon

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,frontend -c blue,magenta "npm run dev --workspace server" "npm run start --workspace frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace server && npm run build --workspace frontend
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace server && npm run test --workspace frontend
scripts.lint: npm run lint --workspace server && npm run lint --workspace frontend
scripts.postinstall: echo 'Root install complete. Copy .env.example to .env before running the server.'
